description: This file defines the StaticResourcesHolder class, which implements ThemeResourcesHolder and provides access to various UI resource properties such as text colors and backgrounds for a keyboard overlay.

classes.name: StaticResourcesHolder
classes.description: A class that holds static resource references for theme customization, including text colors and background drawables.

methods.name: StaticResourcesHolder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes resource references for key text color, hint text color, name text color, key background, and keyboard background.

methods.name: getKeyTextColor
methods.description: Returns the color state list for key text.

methods.name: getNameTextColor
methods.description: Returns the text color for names.

methods.name: getKeyBackground
methods.description: Returns the drawable used as the key background.

methods.name: getKeyboardBackground
methods.description: Returns the drawable used as the keyboard background.
